text: In a 50 mL round-bottom flask, MFU-4l (0.100 g, 0.08 mmol) was suspended in methanol (5 mL). A methanol solution of lithium 2,2′-bipyridine-4,4′-dicarboxylate (8 mM, 0.008–0.040 mmol for x = 0.1–0.5) was added to the MOF suspension dropwise. The resulting mixture was stirred at 300 rpm for 20 h, and the solid was isolated by vacuum filtration.

source.title: Regioselective Arene C–H Borylation with a MOF-Immobilized Iridium Bipyridine Catalyst
